# Identity Intake Checklist: Identity-Locked I Heart PR Tours Brand Guide

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of S028's source-authority, typography, transformation, privacy, and approval-gate requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all intake file classes and required metadata specified, including identity, font, guide, favicon, and reference roles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002 to FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are explicit rules defined for excluding contracts, registrations, credentials, personal records, and unrelated neighboring files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the authority hierarchy complete for vector, raster, PDF, favicon, lockup, wordmark, and guide references? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all Gate 1 packet elements and approval bindings enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007 to FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are font identity, metadata, provenance, licensing, redistribution, and offline-delivery requirements all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the required lineage fields specified for every permitted derivative? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Are Gate 2 packet contents and publication decisions fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, FR-024]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is `reference-art` clearly distinguished from an authoritative production master? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004 to FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the prohibition on rebuilding logo lettering from live type unambiguous across all source formats? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Scope Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK010 Is a non-creative transformation defined by a closed, source-specific operation list rather than subjective visual similarity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013 to FR-014]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the treatment of fixed colors that fail text contrast explicit and distinct from changing the identity palette? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK012 Is public eligibility distinguished from repository pull-request review and from customer-facing publication? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, FR-024]
- [ ] CHK013 Is `Source Sans 3/Pro` identified as an owner decision instead of a permitted synonym? [Ambiguity resolved, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do source-preservation rules align across the specification, source contract, data model, and delivery plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Delivery Sequence]
- [ ] CHK015 Do both approval gates use consistent invalidation semantics for source, geometry, framing, color, typography, copy, and transformation changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, FR-018]
- [ ] CHK016 Does mandatory website publication align with third-party affiliation, the visible ownership boundary, and the prohibition on inferred service credit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010 to FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Do unavailable-variant requirements consistently prefer owner disposition over creative completion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the planned approved-canonical S027 lifecycle align with the prohibition on using a historical baseline for this new intake? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can complete intake coverage be measured without discovering or opening unrelated files? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Can source-byte preservation be measured at intake, promotion, committed source, and build input? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Can Gate 1 completeness be evaluated against a finite field set and exact packet digest? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK022 Can derivative lineage completeness be measured for every generated identity output? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Are proof sizes, surfaces, and preserved visual properties objective enough for Gate 2 review? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK024 Can public-discovery denial be verified independently before and after Gate 2? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are conflicting source representations, metadata, crop, and color definitions addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are missing standalone masters and formats unsupported by authoritative mode addressed before implementation? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK027 Are proprietary, unavailable, ambiguously named, or non-redistributable fonts addressed without substitution? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK028 Are website drift, downloaded media, and current-copy changes bounded as non-authoritative context? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Are generator-assumption failures handled without modifying the source to satisfy the tool? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-021]
- [ ] CHK030 Are automated-review requests for identity changes routed back to the appropriate owner gate? [Recovery, Spec §User Story 4]

## Non-Functional and Dependency Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Are WCAG 2.1 AA requirements defined for every relevant semantic and identity role without waivers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK032 Are unsafe path, rollback, stale approval, and private-data boundaries explicit in the test requirements? [Security, Spec §FR-022, FR-025]
- [ ] CHK033 Are Python 3.8, artifact-boundary, encoding, and full-CI compatibility constraints included? [Dependency, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK034 Is merged S027 explicitly required before canonical approval or derivative generation? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the exact conditions for halting at Gate 1, Gate 2, and owner merge specified without conflict with autopilot? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, FR-017, FR-024]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
